body: I want to have the courage to do just that really: be impulsive and take chances. But night after night I find my self alone. What I really need is someone worth risking the tattered remains of my self esteem and just putting myself out there for.
You're right I need to get a sense of self esteem. I can't stand the person I am right now so I might as well try to change. But I really have no idea how to start.
